# Cabinet

Cabinet is a private watch collection app.

Shared wishlist links are public to anyone with the URL and are available in four formats:

- Human-readable HTML: `/share/{token}`
- Compact plain text: `/share/{token}.txt`
- Agent-friendly Markdown: `/share/{token}.md`
- Machine-readable JSON: `/share/{token}.json`

Shared wishlist pages include watch brand, model, price in AED, category, movement, case size, source URL, reference number when available, and signed image URLs when available.
